name: Tavily
summary: Real-time search, extraction and crawling APIs for AI agents.
description: Tavily provides APIs that give AI agents access to the web: search, extraction of clean content, research, crawling and site mapping. The Researcher plan is free with 1,000 API credits per month; pay-as-you-go costs $0.008 per credit, and monthly Project plans start at $30. Startups can apply for 100,000 free credits, and students can use it for free. The company also offers industry solutions for finance and insurance.

howToUse.title: Open Tavily
howToUse.description: Open Tavily and start for free so your agents can reach the web through the API.

howToUse.title: Search the web
howToUse.description: Copy the setup prompt, then call search so the agent gets relevant web results.

howToUse.title: Extract, research, crawl, or map
howToUse.description: Use extraction when you need clean content, research for a deeper question, crawling for a whole site, or mapping to list URLs.

howToUse.title: Check credits and industries
howToUse.description: Researcher includes 1,000 API credits each month. Startups can apply for a larger grant, and students can use Tavily without paying. The company offers industry solutions for finance and for insurance.

features_fr: API de recherche, d'extraction et d'exploration en temps réel pour les agents IA.
Tavily fournit des API qui permettent aux agents d'IA d'accéder au Web : recherche, extraction de contenu propre, recherche, exploration et cartographie du site.
Le forfait Chercheur est gratuit avec 1 000 crédits API par mois ; le paiement à l'utilisation coûte 0,008 $ par crédit et les forfaits mensuels Project commencent à 30 $.
Les startups peuvent demander 100 000 crédits gratuits et les étudiants peuvent les utiliser gratuitement.
